headline: Sri Lanka stocks close down 0.60-pct, turnover Rs1.05bn
summary: Sri Lanka's stock market closed 0.60% lower, with turnover of Rs1.05 billion. Hatton National Bank, Digital Mobility, Ambeon Holdings and Janashakthi were among the positive contributors to the ASPI index.
why: The All Share Price Index tracks the Colombo Stock Exchange and reflects the performance of the country's listed companies.
